IRB Infrastructure Developers to announce Q1FY27                          
results on Thursday 30thJuly, 2026. 
July 27, 2026, Mumbai: IRB Infrastructure Developers Ltd. (Reuters: IRBI.BO, Bloomberg: IRB:IN, NSE: 
IRB, BSE: 532947) will announce results for the quarter ended June 30th, 2026, on Thursday, July 30th 
2026. The results will also be available on the Company website: www.irb.co.in. 
Earnings call (4.00 p.m. IST on July 30th, 2026) 
The Company will conduct an earnings call at 4.00 p.m. IST on Thursday, July 30th, 2026. To participate 
in this conference call, please dial the numbers provided below, ten minutes ahead of the scheduled start 
time. The operator will provide instructions for participation and process for asking questions. A transcript 
of this conference call will be available on the website subsequently.
